svg.text: A. Split Empty-Policy Permission Hashing
core/src/context/world_state/permissions.rs — avoiding 32 KiB re-emissions
PermissionsSnapshot::Current { instructions, approved_command_prefixes }
• instructions = WorldStateHash(build_instructions(&Policy::empty()))
• approved_command_prefixes = BTreeSet<Vec<String>> (sorted rule tokens)
Decouples static sandbox prose hash from monotonically growing allow-rules!
User clicks "Always allow `cargo test`"
Subset Fast Path: previous_prefixes.is_subset(current_prefixes)
1. Base empty-policy hash matches -> static prose did NOT change.
2. Compute set difference: ΔP = current_prefixes \ previous_prefixes.
3. Append 1-line ApprovedCommandPrefixSaved(ΔP) (~28 tokens vs. 4,000!)
Fallback Path (Policy Revocation or Sandbox Profile Change)
If a rule was removed (previous ⊈ current) or empty-policy hash changed,
falls back to emitting full PermissionsInstructions at the conversation tail.
B. Four Companion Cache-Preserving Micro-Patterns
Eliminating clock jitter, mode-toggle churn, and cold subagent routing
1. Date-Only Clock (%Y-%m-%d) & LazyLock Shell Cache
Never formats HH:MM:SS timestamps; caches PowerShell versions in process
memory; emits <environment_context> only on true field-level mutation.
2. Runtime Tool Rejection Over Schema Deletion (plan.rs)
Toggling Plan Mode keeps update_plan in Prompt.tools; PlanHandler returns
RespondToModel("not allowed in Plan mode") -> 0 tool-schema churn!
3. Tail <model_switch> & SuppressModelChangeAnnouncements
Mid-thread model swaps keep historical base_instructions frozen and append
only delta model guidance at the tail (or 0 tokens on silent alias shifts).
4. SessionDerived PromptCacheKey + Routing Affinity Cookies
Guardian sub-sessions use "{source}:{parent_thread_id}" + parent_routing_
affinity to land on the exact backend cluster holding warm parent KV blocks.
